nodes.label: Text boxes have built-in internal padding
nodes.text: Text boxes have built-in internal padding — set margin: 0 whenever text must align with a shape, line, or icon at the same x.

nodes.label: Let bullets inherit from the layout
nodes.text: Let bullets inherit from the layout; only add ,  (numbered), or  to override — never a literal • in the text.

nodes.label: contain parts the XSD rejects, so
nodes.text: contain parts the XSD rejects, so a bare run can report failures you never caused — and

nodes.label: pptxgenjs mutates option objects in place
nodes.text: pptxgenjs mutates option objects in place (converts values to EMU on first use). Never share one shadow/options object across two add* calls — build a fresh object each time.

nodes.label: Shadow offset must be ≥ 0
nodes.text: Shadow offset must be ≥ 0 — a negative offset corrupts the file. To cast a shadow upward, use angle: 270 with a positive offset.

nodes.label: Lists: bullet: true on each item
nodes.text: Lists: bullet: true on each item, never a literal • (renders double bullets). Set breakLine: true on every array item except the last. Space bulleted paragraphs with paraSpaceAfter, not lineSpacing (huge gaps).

nodes.label: One new pptxgen() per output file
nodes.text: One new pptxgen() per output file — never reuse an instance.
